name: Ichinomiya Mika
source:
>Miko

A miko working at the shrine located in the old Umitsubame Town.

Since she was young, she has been involved with many elderly people and has grown to have a very calm personality. She has a warm and fluffy aura around her and is liked by all the townspeople. As all the town residents have always been patrons of the shrine, she is very worried about the town's future.

Despite her gentle personality, she has a firm will and is ready to do anything for the sake of the shrine and the town as a miko.

She's a resident of Umitsubame Town.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/natsuyo/character5.html]Official Site[/url]]
